context: The flowchart sums the integers from 1 to n, where n is positive. The running total starts at 0. On each iteration, the step labeled “Task” adds the current i to the total.

frames.explanation: Set i = 1, then check whether i ≤ n. If true, perform the task, increment i by 1, and go straight back to the condition check. If false, exit. Initialization happens only once, before the loop starts. Each new iteration picks up the current i.
frames.title: A single loop

result: The task runs once for each i from 1 through n, for n executions in all. When the update sets i to n + 1, the condition becomes false and the loop ends.
summary: Initialization, a condition check, and an update determine how often a task repeats.
title: A single loop
